scope: GNUCOBOL numeric-class primitive probe; not B04 layout acceptance
source:
identification division.
       program-id. packed-probe.
       data division.
       working-storage section.
       01 packed-value pic s9(3)v99 comp-3.
       01 packed-raw redefines packed-value pic x(3).
       01 signed-out pic +999.99.
       procedure division.
           move x"12345C" to packed-raw
           perform check-value
           move x"12345F" to packed-raw
           perform check-value
           move x"12345D" to packed-raw
           perform check-value
           move x"12A45C" to packed-raw
           perform check-value
           move x"12345E" to packed-raw
           perform check-value
           goback.
       check-value.
           if packed-value is numeric
               move packed-value to signed-out
               display "VALID:" signed-out
           else
               display "INVALID"
           end-if.
